Lab settings

Real coast at 20 m per pixel, start area Lysekil to Käringön. Boat speed is sped up for the lab. Distances on tags are real kilometres and game minutes at 1:10. Red dots are granddad's marks; before you've been close, places only show a description ("Goose Isle", "the shallow sound"); the real name appears once you've been close, and the chart's fog lifts where you've sailed. Set the year to 1700: lighthouses don't exist yet, so their rocks show as plain skerries under their real names; only the big chart sections get lore names.
